svg.text: GHOSTED: Recruiter Ricky body map v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-25)
Decided before the sheet: proportions in head-heights, landmarks, attachment points, the drain mapping to the Ghostie, and a check at the game camera (26 m, pitch 42, yaw 20).
chin / neck line, collar top y 152
PROPORTIONS (head = top of quiff to chin = 114 units)
Height 304 units = 1.00 m = 1.05 x Kit (0.95 m).
Head 112 wide; jacket 136 at the shoulders, 148 at the hem.
Legs 50 (hem to ankle), shoes 22: short, like Kit.
Eye line y 98; eyes x 132 / 168 (ink ovals + glint).
Ears: on the eye line at the head sides (x 94 / 206),
small; the headset cups cover them.
Mouth zone x 125-175, y 110-134: a wide grin.
It fades in drain step 2 (a ghost never replies).
Neck: hidden. Chin y 150 = neck line; a white shirt
collar rings the neck (value break, all views).
Shoulder joint (red): x 84 / 216, y 176. The arm
root. Sleeve to the cuff at the wrist y 234.
Hands: skin balls at y 246, beside the hem.
Headset band: centred over the crown, top y 32,
in the ear plane (6 units behind the centre).
Headset cups: ONE ON EACH EAR POINT,
centre x 89 / 211, y 100. Mic boom from the
right cup (viewer-left) to the mouth corner.
Tie: centred on x 150, knot top y 160 under the
shirt collar at the neck line y 152; V point y 232,
inside the shirt V (V point y 238).
D. GAME CAMERA CHECK (x3). Left: Ricky estimate. Middle: same, landmark dots
(blue: eyes, mouth, knot, tie V, hands, hem, feet; red: cups, band top). Right: Kit, real v7 render.
Scale: drawn at 1.05 x Kit's real screen height (76 px); see notes.md.
E. DRAIN MAPPING: each Ricky landmark becomes a Ghostie landmark (same metres; Ghostie from its locked body map)

ears and the tie stays centred under a collar in every drain step.
